OAuth 2.0 token endpoints

The Texas Instruments Store API provides programmatic access to TI's ordering and inventory platform. It enables enterprise customers to retrieve real-time inventory and pricing, create and retrieve orders, and track shipments via Advanced Ship Notice (ASN). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow against the transact.ti.com token endpoint.
